gen_risks.description: Insufficient funding for schools to deliver free breakfast clubs, leading to reduced participation and effectiveness
gen_risks.mitigation: Conduct regular reviews of school funding and adjust as necessary to ensure adequate support

gen_risks.description: Difficulty in recruiting and retaining skilled staff to deliver free breakfast clubs, impacting quality of provision
gen_risks.mitigation: Provide training and support for staff, and consider incentives for recruitment and retention

gen_risks.description: Inequitable access to free breakfast clubs, with some schools or areas struggling to participate or deliver effective provision
gen_risks.mitigation: Monitor participation and delivery, and provide targeted support to schools or areas that need it
gen_risks.evidence: Strategic case: accessibility and affordability challenges

gen_risks.description: Delays or difficulties in implementing the customer relationship management system, impacting school support and engagement
gen_risks.mitigation: Prioritize system development and testing, and provide alternative support mechanisms in the interim
gen_risks.evidence: Commercial case: customer relationship management system

gen_risks.description: Insufficient or inadequate food provision, impacting pupil health and wellbeing
gen_risks.mitigation: Develop and enforce food standards, and monitor school compliance
gen_risks.evidence: Key assumptions: food provided must be in line with school food standards

gen_risks.description: Difficulty in engaging parents and carers, impacting participation and effectiveness of free breakfast clubs
gen_risks.mitigation: Develop targeted engagement strategies, and provide support for schools to build relationships with parents and carers
gen_risks.evidence: Evaluation plan: explore parent and school perspectives

gen_risks.description: Inadequate infrastructure or resources, impacting ability of schools to deliver free breakfast clubs
gen_risks.mitigation: Conduct needs assessments, and provide support for schools to develop necessary infrastructure and resources
gen_risks.evidence: Key assumptions: schools are provided with initial funding to cover essential equipment, training and systems

gen_risks.description: Changes in government policy or funding, impacting the viability or effectiveness of free breakfast clubs
gen_risks.mitigation: Monitor policy developments, and engage with stakeholders to advocate for the programme
gen_risks.evidence: Rationale for the choice of preferred option: aligns with strategic objectives

gen_risks.description: Difficulty in collecting and analyzing data, impacting evaluation and improvement of free breakfast clubs
gen_risks.mitigation: Develop and implement effective data collection and analysis systems, and provide support for schools to use data to inform practice

gen_risks.description: Inadequate support for schools with complex delivery challenges, impacting effectiveness of free breakfast clubs
gen_risks.mitigation: Provide targeted support for schools with complex needs, and develop strategies to address specific challenges
gen_risks.evidence: Commercial case: support package for schools

gen_risks.description: Difficulty in managing and mitigating risks, impacting overall effectiveness and sustainability of free breakfast clubs
gen_risks.mitigation: Develop and implement effective risk management processes, and provide support for schools to manage and mitigate risks
gen_risks.evidence: Risk and issue management: overall cautious approach to risk

gt_risks.description: Lower value for money compared to the 'do minimum' option in year 1, due to the shorter funding period available for the preferred option's new cohorts of schools.
Delivery risks around staffing and food costs for schools newly onboarded to the free breakfast clubs programme.
gt_risks.mitigation: Mitigated through early adopter (EA) scheme insights and support funding.

gt_risks.description: Uncertainty in the labour-market benefits (parental workforce participation gains) the programme is expected to deliver.
gt_risks.mitigation: Addressed through conservative assumptions in the economic modelling.
